# The Milano Seal™ — Paid & Released Email Template

**Use:** Send to client after courier release / digital document delivery  
**Sender:** Nicholas Milano (direct, not automated)  
**Timing:** Within 2 hours of courier release or digital delivery upload

---

## Template

**Subject:** Your Documents Are Released — Matter [DISPLAY_ID]

---

[Client First Name],

Your matter is paid and released.

**Matter:** [DISPLAY_ID]  
**Document:** [DOCUMENT_TYPE]  
**Destination:** [DESTINATION_COUNTRY]

---

**[FOR PHYSICAL COURIER]**

Your executed documents have been released for delivery.

**Carrier:** [CARRIER_NAME]  
**Tracking:** [TRACKING_NUMBER]  
**Estimated Delivery:** [ESTIMATED_DATE]

You can track your shipment directly at [CARRIER_TRACKING_URL].

Your secure matter portal also reflects the current delivery status in real time.

---

**[FOR DIGITAL / RON DELIVERY]**

Your executed documents are available in your secure matter portal.

Log in at: themilanoseal.com/portal  
Navigate to: Document Vault

Your documents are available for download for 72 hours. If you need extended access, reply to this message.

---

Your chain-of-custody record is complete. Every execution event has been logged and is accessible through your portal.

If you have any questions about your documents or next steps, reply directly to this message.

—

Nicholas Milano  
The Milano Seal™  
FL Notary #668288  
International Document Execution  
themilanoseal.com

---

## Usage Notes

- Replace all `[BRACKETED]` fields with matter-specific data
- Remove the courier OR digital section (do not include both)
- Do NOT include internal matter ID beyond `display_id`
- Do NOT include Wise reference, payment details, or pricing in this email
- Do NOT include discount information or pricing overrides
- Portal link is always `themilanoseal.com/portal` — not a direct deep link
